notes.title: Project Solaris Demo Ver.0.6 Major Update Released!
notes.content:
[p]Project Solaris Demo Ver.0.6 Update Details
[/p][p]Ver.0.6 brings a wide range of updates including combat system improvements, UI enhancements, and updated tutorials.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]▼ Major Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added skill enhancement system & new animations for Hom’s skills
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277471/37ed3ea1178d9285e8c86a8037f6332cb779f4a4.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Buff and debuff effects greatly expanded (from 5 types to 38)[/p][/*][*][p]Initial Hom skills changed (from 3 types to 6)[/p][/*][*][p]Revised how Hom's skills are selected during each turn
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277471/60756a99ef8754630679c5f44138ddc05a200c95.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Revamped card graphics in the card selection screen[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277471/1386413c654294315ca9a4c6644bdc7939a0874a.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Skill list now shows color coding and level indicators[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment section in the development screen improved (added animated cursor)[/p][/*][*][p]Buff/debuff effect descriptions now appear on mouse hover in the help section[/p][/*][*][p]Added pop-up descriptions for battle and interaction rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced the ratio of battle/interaction rewards[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced overall game data size and memory usage[/p][/*][*][p]Fully reworked tutorial content[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]📢 Please try out the updated demo and let us know your feedback![/p]
